$comment: DERIVED, not verbatim. Written by this library. The test cases run by check-schemas.derived.py against the derived schemas of w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0 (REC-vc-data-integrity-20250515, sha256 ba5c4baf13fe3bab3ebd95ab6650d6fe83720e254b383bb444b4fbbae7bcf4fe). Each case names its engine (jsonschema: JSON Schema 2020-12; xfield: a cross-field rule of rules.derived.yaml), its target (a schema file, optionally with an anchor, relative to urn:library:w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0:) and the expected verdict. Synthetic instances are inline; example instances are named by fixture file and path. A case marked limitation records something the schema accepts and the source's rule would reject.
